unit.why: A single narrative about the Maggid of Kozienice ruling against permitting an agunah to remarry against the Yeshuot Yaakov, his position confirmed when the husband returns as the letter arrives.

stories.start_quote: בס׳ דברים ערבים משמו כי הגאון
stories.summary_en: The Yeshuot Yaakov would permit an agunah to remarry only with the consent of the Maggid of Kozienice; the Maggid forbade it and wrote that the husband would come home when his letter arrived, and the husband indeed returned just as the delayed letter was opened.
